guidelines.detail: documentation rule ACT-04 not applied (The description says a penalty is automatically demanded from an external participant, and the validator confirms that messageRef on a serviceTask is invalid. ACT-04 already directs modelers to use a send task when sending a message is the modeled work.)

same as LRN-089 (The description states that a penalty depends on waiting more than ten days. The reference uses a gateway to test that condition after the wait, while the generated model uses a boundary event instead; this matches learned guideline LRN-089.)

refines FLOW-06 (The description supports a repeated item-processing cycle followed by an overall completion check. The records show different flow placement around that check and the return to item checking; this guideline makes the convergence and loop routing explicit, refining FLOW-06's guidance on tracing splits and adding joins when paths reunite.)

same as LRN-090 (The description confirms that the alternative item-processing paths share a completion check and that an incomplete order leads to selecting another item and repeating the check. The flow differences show the generated model did not preserve that convergence and loop structure. This guideline is already stated essentially the same way by LRN-090.)

refines EVT-06 (The description provides the title “Storage management” but no explicit trigger, while the generated start event uses the generic label “Start” and the reference uses the title. This adds a labeling instruction to EVT-06’s guidance for starts with no stated trigger.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: Use bpmn:sendTask or bpmn:receiveTask when sending or waiting for a message is itself the modeled unit of work.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that work includes sending a request or message to an external participant

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description makes a follow-up action depend on whether a waiting period exceeds a stated duration: model the duration check with an exclusive gateway after the wait, route the conditional action along its applicable branch, and merge the paths before their shared continuation
rules_sent_back.situation: the description makes a follow-up action depend on whether a waiting period exceeds a stated duration

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that items are processed iteratively, that overall completion is checked after an item is processed, and that an incomplete result leads to selecting another item and repeating the item-level check: Model the item-processing outcomes to converge before the overall completion check, and route the incomplete outcome through the next-item selection back to the item-level check.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that items are processed iteratively, that overall completion is checked after an item is processed, and that an incomplete result leads to selecting another item and repeating the item-level check

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity with explicit alternatives or qualifiers that distinguish its scope: Label the corresponding BPMN element concisely while preserving those stated distinctions; do not generalize them away.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity, decision, or outcome with details such as its object, scope, or recipient

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description gives a process title but states no explicit start trigger: Label the start event with a concise form of the process title rather than a generic label.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description gives a process title but states no explicit start trigger
